slipDiagnosis.definition: Point sample distributions of relative velocityAtPoint horizontal speed. Confirmed=c.hasSupport and native solverPoint.withinSlop. NonPredictive also requires solver distance<=0 and an actual/fresh geometry gap<=0. rawPositive is manifold sum>0; individual impulse entries cannot be paired to solver points. stanceFlag is separate from activeStance.
limits: One seed and these controlled inputs only; not human naturalness or population evidence.
Point-sample distribution is not original per-frame maximum distribution. Contact duration/number of points differs between models.
Raw positive normal impulse is per manifold, not an individually matched solver point load. No impulse-to-force bodywide correction.
AfterFirstStand starts at identical time between models for each getup scene; afterLevHEnd starts at different times and is not a common window.
Actual solver point relative velocity is measured; pelvis displacement is net forward progress, not slip or path length.
Native solver cached points with nonzero impulse can fail current fresh geometry hasSupport and are excluded.
slipDiagnosis.conclusion: Largest unfiltered peaks are unsupported swing/cached points; loaded active stance walking regression remains after filtering. Healthy afterFirstStand mean/p95 increase; hurt mean/p95 increase slightly while maximum decreases. No default promotion based on unfiltered aggregate.
slipDiagnosis.portableReproduction: Apply tools/sim/experiments/support_slip_observation.patch in a separate worktree; run tools/sim/support_transfer_probe.mjs with the same CLI arguments. Original measurement used an external worker; only path/metadata locations differ in the portable patch.
